title: Mahuri: breath within the ensemble
coverage_gap: Existing Sankha story names Mahuri as accompaniment; no dedicated instrument narrative existed. This article connects that existing reference with a specimen record and institutional ensemble descriptions.

claim_boundaries: Double-reed description is supported by ICCR and the museum catalogue. A conflicting single-reed label in a secondary search result was not adopted.
Wooden and metal bells refer to separate described examples; no universal construction specification asserted.
2019 is the museum acquisition year only. No invention, ancient lineage or extraction-history inference.
Kalahandi row 04 Singh Baja supports its ensemble. Row 02 spells Manuri; that spelling was not silently normalized or used as separate corroboration.
No quotations, lyrics, museum photograph, practitioner contact details or audio reused.
Listening questions are editorial prompts, not recorded observations.
future_research: Named makers and musicians, with appropriate consent and preferred credit.
